questions.stem: The central bank announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year in an effort to slow rising prices.
Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses in the months ahead.
To avoid a lawsuit, a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital.
At the talks, the family said the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss.
Speakers at the conference agreed that translators must stay ______ to the original while making it sound natural.
Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______, since jokes based on sound rarely work in another language.
The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor: take nothing but photos and leave nothing but footprints.
The eco-tour plan will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics.
At the charity gala, the largest gift came from a donor who gave ______, asking that her name not be made public.
Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group, which organized tonight's gala at the city's grand hotel.

tags.topic: 情境組：央行利率決議、醫療糾紛調解、翻譯研討會、生態旅遊規劃、慈善晚宴

1.explanation_zh: hike 常見意思是「健行、徒步旅行」，也指「（價格、稅、利率的）大幅調升」，an interest-rate hike 是「升息」。央行宣布今年第三次升息，以抑制不斷上漲的物價。
evidence: announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year
in an effort to slow rising prices

option_notes_zh.A: climb「攀爬；上升」：雖然也有「上升」的意思，但英文不說 an interest-rate climb 表示升息決策；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.C: march「行軍、遊行」：和 hike 都是「走路」，沒有「調升」的意思。
option_notes_zh.D: walk「散步」：an interest-rate walk 沒有意義。

1.strategy_zh: 四個選項都和走路、爬山有關。interest-rate ____ 要表示「央行調升利率」，固定說法是 rate hike。後面 to slow rising prices（抑制物價上漲）說明是升息而不是降息。
hints: 空格是名詞，前面有 interest-rate 修飾。
為了抑制物價上漲，央行對利率做了什麼？
march、walk 只是走路；答案原意是「健行」。

2.explanation_zh: stimulate 意為「刺激、激勵（使活躍）」，stimulate spending／the economy 是常見搭配。經濟學家預期，這次降息將刺激家庭和企業在未來幾個月增加消費與支出。
evidence: Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses

option_notes_zh.A: thrill「使興奮、使激動」：中文也可說「刺激」，但只用於人的情緒（The news thrilled us.），不能說 thrill spending；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.B: estimate「估計」：降息不會「估計」消費，句意不通。
option_notes_zh.D: irritate「激怒；刺激（皮膚）」：是負面的刺激，不能接 spending。

2.strategy_zh: rate cut（降息）讓借錢變便宜，目的就是讓家庭和企業多花錢。受詞是 spending，要選 stimulate（刺激經濟活動）。thrill、irritate 中文雖然也能翻成「刺激」，但對象是人的情緒或身體。
hints: 空格是原形動詞，受詞是 spending（支出、消費）。
降息會讓家庭和企業的消費增加還是減少？
thrill 只用於人的情緒；答案也常接 the economy。

3.explanation_zh: mediate 意為「調解、居中協調」，mediate between A and B 是常見句型。為了避免訴訟，一位退休法官受邀在病人家屬和醫院之間居中調解。
evidence: To avoid a lawsuit
a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital

option_notes_zh.B: meditate「冥想、沉思」：和 mediate 只差一個字母，意思完全不同。
option_notes_zh.C: dominate「支配、主宰」：法官不是去主宰雙方，而且不和 between 搭配。
option_notes_zh.D: interfere「干涉、介入」：雖然也表示介入兩方之間，但帶有「不受歡迎地插手」的負面意思，和「受邀（was asked）」不合；是近似干擾。

3.strategy_zh: To avoid a lawsuit（為了避免訴訟）和 between the patient's family and the hospital（在家屬與醫院之間）說明法官的角色是居中協調。mediate 和 meditate 字形只差一個 t，要小心分辨。
hints: 空格是原形動詞，後面接 between A and B。
為了不打官司，退休法官在家屬和醫院之間扮演什麼角色？
meditate 是冥想；答案的名詞是 mediator（調解人）。

4.explanation_zh: chilly 原意是「寒冷的、涼颼颼的」，形容態度時引申為「冷淡的、不友善的」，a chilly manner 指「冷淡的態度」。在協商中，家屬表示外科醫師冷淡的態度，讓他們覺得他根本不在乎他們失去親人的痛。
evidence: the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss

option_notes_zh.A: wet「濕的」：a wet manner 不是英文說法。
option_notes_zh.B: damp「潮濕的」：和 chilly 同樣描述令人不舒服的天氣，但不能形容人的態度；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.C: rainy「下雨的」：只描述天氣，不能形容態度。

4.strategy_zh: made them feel that he did not care（讓他們覺得他不在乎）說明醫師的態度很冷淡。四個選項都是天氣形容詞，只有 chilly 能像 cold、cool 一樣引申為「冷淡的」。
hints: 空格是形容詞，修飾 manner（態度）。
醫師的態度讓家屬覺得他不在乎：這是什麼樣的態度？
damp、wet、rainy 都和水有關；答案和 cold 意思相近。

5.explanation_zh: faithful 原意是「忠實的、忠誠的」（對人），用在翻譯、複製時引申為「忠於原作的、準確的」，stay faithful to the original 是常見說法。研討會上的講者都同意，譯者必須忠於原文，同時讓譯文讀起來自然。
evidence: translators must stay ______ to the original while making it sound natural

option_notes_zh.A: kind「仁慈的」：kind to 也只能接人或動物。
option_notes_zh.B: polite「有禮貌的」：polite to 只能接人，不能接原文。
option_notes_zh.D: honest「誠實的」：和 faithful 都有「忠誠老實」的意思，但英文不說 honest to the original；是近似干擾。

5.strategy_zh: 固定搭配 faithful to the original（忠於原文）。while making it sound natural（同時讓譯文自然）是翻譯的兩大要求：準確與通順。四個選項都形容人的品格，只有 faithful 能用在譯文和原作的關係上。
hints: 空格是形容詞，後面接 to the original。
好的譯文和原文之間應該是什麼關係？
honest 只是「誠實」；答案的名詞是 faith（信念、忠誠）。

6.explanation_zh: nightmare 原意是「惡夢」，引申為「極其困難、令人頭痛的事」，sb's worst nightmare 是常見說法。文字遊戲常被說是譯者最頭痛的難題，因為靠發音製造的笑點，很少能在另一種語言裡成立。
evidence: Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______
since jokes based on sound rarely work in another language

option_notes_zh.A: dream「夢；夢想」：英文不說 sb's worst dream，而且 dream 常指美好的夢想；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.C: nap「小睡」：同樣不能表示令人頭痛的事。
option_notes_zh.D: sleep「睡眠」：a translator's worst sleep 沒有意義。

6.strategy_zh: since 後面說明原因：靠發音的笑話很難翻譯。所以文字遊戲是譯者「最頭痛的事」，固定說法是 sb's worst nightmare。四個選項都和睡覺有關，只有 nightmare 能引申為「惡夢般的難題」。
hints: 空格是名詞，前面有 a translator's worst。
靠發音的笑話很難翻成另一種語言：文字遊戲對譯者來說是什麼？
dream 是美夢；答案是會把人嚇醒的夢。

7.explanation_zh: golden 原意是「金色的、金製的」，the golden rule 是固定說法，意為「最重要的原則、金科玉律」。這家旅行社對每位遊客只有一條最重要的守則：除了照片什麼都不帶走，除了腳印什麼都不留下。
evidence: The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor
take nothing but photos and leave nothing but footprints

option_notes_zh.B: copper「銅色的」：同樣不能表示最重要的原則。
option_notes_zh.C: silver「銀色的」：和 golden 同屬金屬色，但英文一般不說 the silver rule 表示最重要的守則；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.D: bronze「青銅色的」：a bronze rule 不是常用說法。

7.strategy_zh: 固定說法 a golden rule（最重要的原則）。one ... rule 和冒號後面的內容說明這是旅行社最看重的一條規矩。四個選項都是金屬色，金最珍貴，所以 golden 引申為「最重要的」。
hints: 空格是形容詞，修飾 rule（規則）。
冒號後面那條規矩對生態旅遊來說重不重要？
四個字都是金屬色；答案是奧運冠軍獎牌的顏色。

8.explanation_zh: channel 是名詞「頻道；水道、管道」，轉作動詞時意為「（把資金、精力等）導向、投入（某處）」，channel money into ... 是常見搭配。生態旅遊計畫會把部分門票收入投入島上的學校和診所。
evidence: will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics

option_notes_zh.A: drain「排出（水）；耗盡」：和 channel 一樣與水流有關，但 drain 是「把東西排掉、耗光」，不能表示把錢導向有用的地方；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.B: bridge「在……上架橋」：bridge the gap 是「彌補差距」，不能接 money into 表示投入資金。
option_notes_zh.D: tunnel「挖隧道」：tunnel money into 不是英文說法。

8.strategy_zh: 句型是 ____ part of the money ... into the island's schools and clinics，表示「把錢導向某處」，要選 channel 的轉品用法。四個選項都和水道、交通工程有關，只有 channel 能表示「引導（資金、精力）流向」。
hints: 空格是原形動詞，句型是 ____ money into + 地方。
門票收入的一部分要拿去哪裡？計畫要怎麼處理這筆錢？
drain 是把水排掉；答案的名詞是「頻道、水道」。

9.explanation_zh: anonymously 意為「匿名地」，由 anonymous（匿名的、不具名的）而來。分詞片語 asking that her name not be made public（要求不要公開她的名字）正是「匿名」的說明。
evidence: the largest gift came from a donor who gave ______
asking that her name not be made public

option_notes_zh.A: nervously「緊張地」：和不公開名字無關。
option_notes_zh.B: unanimously「一致地、無異議地」：和 anonymously 字形、發音都相近，但指「全體意見一致」，一個人捐款無所謂一致；是近似干擾。
option_notes_zh.C: previously「先前」：只表示時間，不能說明捐款的方式。

9.strategy_zh: asking that her name not be made public 直接定義了空格：不具名捐款。anonymously 和 unanimously 字形相近，可以這樣記：an-（沒有）＋ onym（名字）＝沒有名字；un(i)-（一）＋ anim（心）＝同一條心。
hints: 空格是副詞，修飾 gave（捐款）。
捐款人要求不要公開她的名字：她是怎麼捐的？
unanimously 是全體一致；答案的形容詞是 anonymous。

10.explanation_zh: umbrella 原意是「雨傘」，under the umbrella of ... 引申為「在……的統籌、保護之下」，指一個大組織統合許多小團體。三十個小型慈善團體都隸屬於一個較大的組織，今晚在市區大飯店舉辦的晚宴就是由它主辦的。
evidence: Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group

option_notes_zh.A: helmet「安全帽」：同樣沒有「統籌、保護」的引申義。
option_notes_zh.C: ceiling「天花板」：under the ceiling of 只有字面上的「在天花板下」，不能表示隸屬關係。
option_notes_zh.D: raincoat「雨衣」：和 umbrella 都能遮雨，但英文沒有 under the raincoat of 的說法；是近似干擾。

10.strategy_zh: 固定說法 under the umbrella of（在……的統籌之下）：一把大傘底下罩著許多人，就像一個大組織統合許多小團體。Thirty small charities 和 one larger group 的對比正是這個意思。
hints: 空格是名詞，固定說法 under the ____ of。
三十個小慈善團體和一個大組織是什麼關係？
raincoat 只能一個人穿；答案可以罩住很多人。

translation_zh.text:
1. 央行宣布今年第三度升息，以抑制不斷上漲的物價。
2. 經濟學家預期，這次降息將在未來幾個月刺激家庭與企業的消費支出。
3. 為了避免訴訟，一位退休法官受邀在病人家屬和醫院之間居中調解。
4. 在協商時，家屬表示，外科醫師冷淡的態度讓他們覺得他根本不在乎他們失去親人的痛。
5. 研討會上的講者一致認為，譯者必須忠於原文，同時讓譯文讀起來自然。
6. 文字遊戲常被說是譯者最頭痛的惡夢，因為靠發音製造的笑點，很少能在另一種語言裡成立。
7. 這家旅行社對每位遊客只有一條金科玉律：除了照片什麼都不帶走，除了腳印什麼都不留下。
8. 這項生態旅遊計畫會把部分門票收入投入島上的學校和診所。
9. 在慈善晚宴上，最大的一筆捐款來自一位匿名捐款人，她要求不要公開她的名字。
10. 三十個小型慈善團體都隸屬於一個較大的組織，今晚在市區大飯店舉辦的晚宴就是由它主辦。

warnings: group.q9: 正解「anonymously」是規則衍生副詞，詞彙表沒有直接列出

evidence: The central bank announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year in an effort to slow rising prices.
1.explanation_zh: interest-rate hike 指升息，為抑制物價上漲的固定搭配。

evidence: Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses in the months ahead.
2.explanation_zh: stimulate spending 指刺激消費，降息的預期效果。

evidence: To avoid a lawsuit, a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital.
3.explanation_zh: mediate between A and B 指在雙方之間調解；meditate 是冥想，interfere 是干涉。

evidence: At the talks, the family said the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss.
4.explanation_zh: chilly manner 指冷淡的態度，對應家屬覺得醫師不在乎。

evidence: Speakers at the conference agreed that translators must stay ______ to the original while making it sound natural.
5.explanation_zh: faithful to the original 指忠於原文，為翻譯的固定搭配。

evidence: Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______, since jokes based on sound rarely work in another language.
6.explanation_zh: one's worst nightmare 指最怕遇到的事，對應雙關語難以翻譯。

evidence: The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor: take nothing but photos and leave nothing but footprints.
7.explanation_zh: golden rule 指最重要的基本守則。

evidence: The eco-tour plan will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics.
8.explanation_zh: channel money into 指把資金導入、投入某處。

evidence: At the charity gala, the largest gift came from a donor who gave ______, asking that her name not be made public.
9.explanation_zh: anonymously 指匿名地，對應要求不公開姓名。

evidence: Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group, which organized tonight's gala at the city's grand hotel.
10.explanation_zh: under the umbrella of 指在某組織的統籌、旗下。

evidence: The central bank announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year in an effort to slow rising prices.
1.explanation_zh: interest-rate hike 指升息；為了抑制物價上漲，故為 hike。

evidence: Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses in the months ahead.
2.explanation_zh: 降息被預期會刺激 stimulate 家庭與企業的消費。

evidence: To avoid a lawsuit, a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital.
3.explanation_zh: mediate between 指在雙方之間調解，以避免訴訟；meditate 為沉思。

evidence: At the talks, the family said the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss.
4.explanation_zh: chilly manner 指態度冷淡，家屬覺得他不在乎；wet/damp/rainy 不修飾 manner。

evidence: Speakers at the conference agreed that translators must stay ______ to the original while making it sound natural.
5.explanation_zh: faithful to the original 為固定搭配，指忠於原文。

evidence: Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______, since jokes based on sound rarely work in another language.
6.explanation_zh: worst nightmare 指最糟的惡夢，比喻最令人頭痛的事。

evidence: The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor: take nothing but photos and leave nothing but footprints.
7.explanation_zh: golden rule 指黃金守則，為首要的原則。

evidence: The eco-tour plan will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics.
8.explanation_zh: channel money into 指把資金導入學校與診所；drain 方向相反。

evidence: At the charity gala, the largest gift came from a donor who gave ______, asking that her name not be made public.
9.explanation_zh: anonymously 指匿名地，與不願公開姓名呼應。

evidence: Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group, which organized tonight's gala at the city's grand hotel.
10.explanation_zh: under the umbrella of 指隸屬於某一總機構之下。

A.evidence: The central bank announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year in an effort to slow rising prices
A.explanation_zh: 央行宣布的一次「升息」是 a rate hike（或 rise、increase）；climb 指數值自行攀升，不是央行宣布的一次調整，interest-rate climb 不是慣用說法。

C.evidence: announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year
C.explanation_zh: march 是「行進、遊行」，interest-rate march 不是英文說法。

D.evidence: announced its third interest-rate ______ of the year
D.explanation_zh: walk 是「走路」，interest-rate walk 不是英文說法。

A.evidence: Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses
A.explanation_zh: thrill 是「使興奮」，受詞要是人；thrill spending 不通。

B.evidence: Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses
B.explanation_zh: estimate 是「估計」，降息不會去「估計」消費，語意不通。

D.evidence: Economists expect the rate cut to ______ spending by families and businesses
D.explanation_zh: irritate 是「激怒、刺激（皮膚）」，受詞是人或身體部位，不能說刺激消費。

B.evidence: a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital
B.explanation_zh: meditate 是「冥想、沉思」，與在兩方之間調解無關，只是字形相近。

C.evidence: a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital
C.explanation_zh: dominate 是「支配、主宰」，不接 between 兩方，也不符合「避免訴訟」的目的。

D.evidence: To avoid a lawsuit, a retired judge was asked to ______ between the patient's family and the hospital
D.explanation_zh: interfere 是帶貶義的「干涉、妨礙」，不會有人「被請去」干涉；為了避免訴訟而居中協調要用 mediate。

A.evidence: the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss
A.explanation_zh: wet 是「潮濕的」，不能形容態度冷淡、不關心。

B.evidence: the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss
B.explanation_zh: damp 是「潮濕的」，不能形容人的態度。

C.evidence: the surgeon's ______ manner made them feel that he did not care about their loss
C.explanation_zh: rainy 是「下雨的」，只形容天氣，不能形容態度。

A.evidence: translators must stay ______ to the original
A.explanation_zh: 「忠於原文」的固定說法是 faithful to the original；kind to 是「對（人）仁慈」，受詞要是人。

B.evidence: translators must stay ______ to the original
B.explanation_zh: polite to 是「對（人）有禮貌」，不能表示忠於原文。

D.evidence: translators must stay ______ to the original
D.explanation_zh: honest 常用 honest with sb／about sth；「忠於原文」的固定搭配是 faithful（或 true）to the original，honest to the original 不是慣用說法。

A.evidence: Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______, since jokes based on sound rarely work in another language
A.explanation_zh: worst nightmare 是「最怕遇到的事」；dream 是正面的「夢想」，不和 worst 搭配，也與「雙關語難以翻譯」的負面語意不合。

C.evidence: Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______
C.explanation_zh: nap 是「小睡」，a translator's worst nap 不通。

D.evidence: Wordplay is often called a translator's worst ______
D.explanation_zh: sleep 是「睡眠」，worst sleep 不能表示最頭痛的難題。

B.evidence: The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor
B.explanation_zh: 「最重要的守則」是 the golden rule；copper rule 不是英文說法。

C.evidence: The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor
C.explanation_zh: 表示「最重要、必須遵守的規則」的固定說法是 golden rule；silver rule 不是一般用來表示「首要守則」的說法。

D.evidence: The tour company has one ______ rule for every visitor
D.explanation_zh: bronze rule 不是英文說法。

A.evidence: will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics
A.explanation_zh: drain 是「把（資源）耗盡、抽乾」，帶負面意義；把門票收入「投入」學校和診所要用 channel。

B.evidence: will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics
B.explanation_zh: bridge 是「搭橋、彌合（差距）」，bridge money into 不是英文說法。

D.evidence: will ______ part of the money from ticket sales into the island's schools and clinics
D.explanation_zh: tunnel 是「挖隧道」，tunnel money into 不是英文說法；把錢導向某處用 channel（或 funnel）。

A.evidence: a donor who gave ______, asking that her name not be made public
A.explanation_zh: asking that her name not be made public 說明她是「匿名」捐款；nervously（緊張地）與此無關。

B.evidence: a donor who gave ______, asking that her name not be made public
B.explanation_zh: unanimously 是「全體一致地」，用在多人意見相同；一位捐款人不能「一致地」捐款。

C.evidence: a donor who gave ______, asking that her name not be made public
C.explanation_zh: previously（先前）與後面「要求不公開姓名」沒有關係，無法說明這個分詞構句。

A.evidence: Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group
A.explanation_zh: under the umbrella of 是「在…的統籌、庇護之下」；under the helmet of 不是英文說法。

C.evidence: Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group
C.explanation_zh: under the ceiling of 是「在…的天花板（上限）之下」，不能表示由一個大組織統籌。

D.evidence: Thirty small charities work under the ______ of one larger group
D.explanation_zh: under the raincoat of 不是英文說法。
